known_space.name: Known Space
known_space.description: Every charted lane the Stellar Nations still bother to patrol. Less of it every year.

veil.name: The Veil
veil.description: A dim, dust-choked galaxy on the frontier. OVERWATCH's current theatre of operations.

corvane.name: Corvane Reach
corvane.description: Contested space. OVERWATCH has not cleared you for it.

drift.name: The Drift
drift.description: No beacons, no lanes, no records. Ships that go in come back late, or not at all.

kessar.name: Kessar System
kessar.description: A tired orange star and a handful of mining claims. Quiet, until recently.

halcyon.name: Halcyon System
halcyon.description: Former colony hub. Comms have been patchy for months.

kharon.name: Kharon Outpost
kharon.description: Research outpost. Silent for nine days. Security AI WARDEN not answering hails.

kessar_iv.name: Kessar IV
kessar_iv.description: Ash world. Survey teams report something living under the crust.

kessar_belt.name: Belt Claim 7
kessar_belt.description: Automated ore refinery. Still running. Nobody remembers who owns it.

halcyon_prime.name: Halcyon Prime
halcyon_prime.description: Colony world, population four million. Last census: overdue.

relay_9.name: Relay Station 9
relay_9.description: Deep-space relay. It has been repeating the same three notes since spring.
